dedupe_keys.name: nilmtk non intrusive load monitoring toolkit

description: NILMTK provides data conversion, preprocessing and evaluation functions for non-intrusive load monitoring. Its contributors publish a Python library that represents buildings, meters and appliances, selects time windows, resamples observations and calculates energy and accuracy metrics. The core also supplies classical reference disaggregators. The current README supports Python 3.11 or newer and provides a command-line converter for preparing HDF5 datasets. GitHub identifies Apache 2.0, allowing free use of the software. Geographic coverage, observation period and time resolution come from each input dataset; NILMTK does not redistribute their licensed data. It can prepare and evaluate appliance-demand components for building simulations using resources such as data-uk-dale-domestic-appliance-level-electricity and data-blond-office-electricity-dataset. A caveat is that maintained neural models and fixed benchmark protocols now belong to companion repositories, so claims about the current core should not be based on older installation guides or algorithm lists. No package installation, dataset conversion or model evaluation was run in this review.
